chapters.title: Chapter 4264 Struggles and Advancements! II
paragraphs: The work began with a burst of cerulean glory, Mana buzzing with majesty!
|Project Update: [Living Existential Armor] - Osmont Specification.|
|Phase 1: Deconstruction and Purification.|
|Analysis: The existing framework contains trace elements designed to stabilize a Complexity/Purity matrix. These are now... redundant. And frankly, a little messy. Removing them now.|
Tendrils of blue mana, now sharp and precise as a scalpel, dove into the skeletal armor.

They moved with a speed and delicacy that was hypnotic, extracting and discarding microscopic components, severing conceptual links, and purifying the existing Omnichalcum frame until it was a pristine, unblemished vessel of pure potential.
It was ridiculously quick when one expanded Mana as if it were nothing! When one did not have to worry about their Everything of Mana!
HUUM!
|Phase 2: Infusion and Forging.|
|Objective: To infuse the purified framework with a dense, controlled concentration of activated Early Omnichalcum, following the schematics for a growth-type, symbiotic armor.|
|This is where the art happens.|
The floating blocks of liquid, stellar-white metal began to flow.

They were not poured or molded; they were woven. Guided by RUIN/EDEN's perfect schematics, the tendrils of mana took the liquid Omnichalcum and began to thread it into the armor's frame, not as a shell, but as a muscular system!

They built up layers of overlapping, articulated plates, each one designed to move and shift with a fluid, organic grace. The stark, brutalist angles of the Justiciar model were softened, refined, given a terrifying, elegant beauty.

The chest plate was forged, a magnificent, layered structure that seemed to echo the design of an Early Creature's breast. The pauldrons were shaped, not as bulky, defensive blocks, but as elegant, wing-like structures that swept back from the shoulders.

The helmet materialized, a sleek, almost featureless design with a single, golden visor that seemed to hold the light of a thousand suns. It was not just armor; it was a piece of art, a sculpture of pure, white-gold power!

Elara watched, her breath caught in her throat. His actions, his control, his sheer, boundless endurance... it was a spectacle that defied her every understanding of what an Elderborn was, of what any being was capable of!
The moment the final piece, a single, golden accent on the gauntlet, was woven into place, a new phenomenon occurred.
The very existence of the laboratory trembled. It was not a physical shaking, but a deep, conceptual shudder, as if reality itself had just flinched.
HUUM!
An Existential Trembling!
It passed after a few seconds, but it left a heavy, suffocating weight in the air, the silent, awestruck recognition of a new, unique, and terrifyingly powerful artifact having been born.
Noah and Elara watched as the completed armor floated before them. It was a masterpiece of white and gold, its surface so pure it seemed to glow with its own inner light.

Intricate golden lines, echoing the design of the Modulator, pulsed with a slow, steady rhythm, like a sleeping heart. Its sheer, condensed immensity was a physical presence, a weight that made the air around it seem to bend.
Elara's eyes shone. She floated forward, her hand reaching out to touch its pristine surface.

She frowned. "It's packed with more Omnichalcum than most other models of Justiciars," she murmured, her scientific curiosity overriding her awe. "The density is... absurd. But... its Purity is so low. Is it defective?"
She could sense its power, yes, but it was nowhere near the 1,000 Quadrillion Purity the standard Justiciar model was designed to possess.
Noah smiled. "I am unable to build something like that that would work with my Modulator," he said, "What was just forged was what is perfect for me. Because it... will grow alongside me."
|[Justiciar, The Aegis of the Architect] has been successfully forged.|
|Classification: Growth-Type Symbiotic Living Existential Armor.|
|Specifications (Phase I):|
| - Primary Boon: Grants a base increase of +300 Quadrillion to Purity.|
| - Augmentations:|
| - [Architect's Eye Integration]: Your perception is now directly linked to the armor's sensory suite, allowing for 360-degree real-time analysis equivalent to half a Fold.|
| - [Weaver's Gauntlets]: The armor's hands are now attuned to the [Existential Artifice] system, reducing the cost of all Weaves by 25% and increasing their precision.|

| - [The Tyrant's Gait]: The armor is intrinsically linked to your Haki. Any movement you make will carry a passive, oppressive weight, a constant, low-grade exertion of your will upon your surroundings.|

|Analysis: The boons shown are only a fraction of the armor's capabilities, Master. Once adorned and fully integrated with [The Keystone Modulator], all effects will be fully ascertained and quantified.|
|Conclusion: Your bespoke suit of existential dominance is ready for fitting. It is recommended you do not wear it to formal events, as it may be considered... ostentatious.|
Justiciar!
The Aegis of the Architect!
The Aegis. The Shield.
His Shield!
HUUM!
Noah looked at the floating, silent armor, at this new, beautiful, and terrible extension of his own will.
He felt the hum of the Modulator on his back, an expectant, eager energy. He had the key. He had the lock. It was time to see what happened when they were brought together.

He was ready to adorn the Living Existential Armor for the first time! The Keystone Modulator, now a seamless, integrated part of his back, hummed with a quiet, powerful rhythm, a second heart beating in time with his own.
He stood before the floating, skeletal framework of the Justiciar, the Aegis of the Architect, its inert, white form a blank canvas awaiting his will.

The front of the armor, the magnificent, layered chest plate, split open with a sound that was both mechanical and organic, a series of interlocking plates retracting like the jaws of some great, celestial beast.
It revealed a dark, humanoid outline within, a space that was not empty, but was filled with a shimmering, expectant energy.
Noah breathed out, a slow, deliberate exhalation, and the blue flames of his Mana buzzed around him, a low, powerful hum.
In an utter show of magisterial glory...
"Come," he commanded!

sentences.text: The work began with a burst of cerulean glory, Mana buzzing with majesty!
|Project Update: [Living Existential Armor] - Osmont Specification.|
|Phase 1: Deconstruction and Purification.|
|Analysis: The existing framework contains trace elements designed to stabilize a Complexity/Purity matrix.
These are now... redundant.
And frankly, a little messy.
Removing them now.|
Tendrils of blue mana, now sharp and precise as a scalpel, dove into the skeletal armor.

They moved with a speed and delicacy that was hypnotic, extracting and discarding microscopic components, severing conceptual links, and purifying the existing Omnichalcum frame until it was a pristine, unblemished vessel of pure potential.
It was ridiculously quick when one expanded Mana as if it were nothing!
When one did not have to worry about their Everything of Mana!
HUUM!
|Phase 2: Infusion and Forging.|
|Objective: To infuse the purified framework with a dense, controlled concentration of activated Early Omnichalcum, following the schematics for a growth-type, symbiotic armor.|
|This is where the art happens.|
The floating blocks of liquid, stellar-white metal began to flow.
They were not poured or molded; they were woven.
Guided by RUIN/EDEN's perfect schematics, the tendrils of mana took the liquid Omnichalcum and began to thread it into the armor's frame, not as a shell, but as a muscular system!
They built up layers of overlapping, articulated plates, each one designed to move and shift with a fluid, organic grace.
The stark, brutalist angles of the Justiciar model were softened, refined, given a terrifying, elegant beauty.
The chest plate was forged, a magnificent, layered structure that seemed to echo the design of an Early Creature's breast.
The pauldrons were shaped, not as bulky, defensive blocks, but as elegant, wing-like structures that swept back from the shoulders.
The helmet materialized, a sleek, almost featureless design with a single, golden visor that seemed to hold the light of a thousand suns.
It was not just armor; it was a piece of art, a sculpture of pure, white-gold power!
Elara watched, her breath caught in her throat.
His actions, his control, his sheer, boundless endurance... it was a spectacle that defied her every understanding of what an Elderborn was, of what any being was capable of!
The moment the final piece, a single, golden accent on the gauntlet, was woven into place, a new phenomenon occurred.
The very existence of the laboratory trembled.
It was not a physical shaking, but a deep, conceptual shudder, as if reality itself had just flinched.
HUUM!
An Existential Trembling!
It passed after a few seconds, but it left a heavy, suffocating weight in the air, the silent, awestruck recognition of a new, unique, and terrifyingly powerful artifact having been born.
Noah and Elara watched as the completed armor floated before them.
It was a masterpiece of white and gold, its surface so pure it seemed to glow with its own inner light.
Intricate golden lines, echoing the design of the Modulator, pulsed with a slow, steady rhythm, like a sleeping heart.
Its sheer, condensed immensity was a physical presence, a weight that made the air around it seem to bend.
Elara's eyes shone.
She floated forward, her hand reaching out to touch its pristine surface.
She frowned.
"It's packed with more Omnichalcum than most other models of Justiciars," she murmured, her scientific curiosity overriding her awe.
"The density is... absurd.
But... its Purity is so low.
Is it defective?"
She could sense its power, yes, but it was nowhere near the 1,000 Quadrillion Purity the standard Justiciar model was designed to possess.
Noah smiled.
"I am unable to build something like that that would work with my Modulator," he said, "What was just forged was what is perfect for me.
Because it... will grow alongside me."
|[Justiciar, The Aegis of the Architect] has been successfully forged.|
|Classification: Growth-Type Symbiotic Living Existential Armor.|
|Specifications (Phase I):|
| - Primary Boon: Grants a base increase of +300 Quadrillion to Purity.|
| - Augmentations:|
| - [Architect's Eye Integration]: Your perception is now directly linked to the armor's sensory suite, allowing for 360-degree real-time analysis equivalent to half a Fold.|
| - [Weaver's Gauntlets]: The armor's hands are now attuned to the [Existential Artifice] system, reducing the cost of all Weaves by 25% and increasing their precision.|
| - [The Tyrant's Gait]: The armor is intrinsically linked to your Haki.
Any movement you make will carry a passive, oppressive weight, a constant, low-grade exertion of your will upon your surroundings.|
|Analysis: The boons shown are only a fraction of the armor's capabilities, Master.
Once adorned and fully integrated with [The Keystone Modulator], all effects will be fully ascertained and quantified.|
|Conclusion: Your bespoke suit of existential dominance is ready for fitting.
It is recommended you do not wear it to formal events, as it may be considered... ostentatious.|
Justiciar!
The Aegis of the Architect!
The Aegis.
The Shield.
His Shield!
HUUM!
Noah looked at the floating, silent armor, at this new, beautiful, and terrible extension of his own will.
He felt the hum of the Modulator on his back, an expectant, eager energy.
He had the key.
He had the lock.
It was time to see what happened when they were brought together.
He was ready to adorn the Living Existential Armor for the first time!
The Keystone Modulator, now a seamless, integrated part of his back, hummed with a quiet, powerful rhythm, a second heart beating in time with his own.
He stood before the floating, skeletal framework of the Justiciar, the Aegis of the Architect, its inert, white form a blank canvas awaiting his will.

The front of the armor, the magnificent, layered chest plate, split open with a sound that was both mechanical and organic, a series of interlocking plates retracting like the jaws of some great, celestial beast.
It revealed a dark, humanoid outline within, a space that was not empty, but was filled with a shimmering, expectant energy.
Noah breathed out, a slow, deliberate exhalation, and the blue flames of his Mana buzzed around him, a low, powerful hum.
In an utter show of magisterial glory...
"Come," he commanded!

chapters.title: Chapter 4265 Struggles and Advancements! III
paragraphs: The armor did not merely move! It responded to him with majesty. It recognized his will, his authority, his very essence!

It floated behind him, its open chassis aligning perfectly with his back. With a soft, almost inaudible click, it descended, its first point of contact the humming, circular engine of the Keystone Modulator.
|Integration Protocol Initiated. Stand by for neural and existential synchronization, Master.|
|The Omnichalcum Core Modulator is establishing its primary connection with [The Aegis of the Architect]. Think of this as plugging the power cord into the wall.|
WAA!
The moment the two pieces of Omnichalcum touched, a brilliant, blue-gold light erupted from the point of connection.
A wave of pure, harmonious energy washed over Noah's being. Then, the suit-up began. It was not a slow, clanking process.

It was a symphony of controlled, violent precision. The backplate clamped onto the Modulator, and then, with a series of rapid, percussive clicks that echoed like a blacksmith's hammer, the rest of the armor flew to him.
The greaves snapped around his legs, the sabatons encasing his feet.
The cuirass wrapped around his torso, the pauldrons locking onto his shoulders with a satisfying, final thud.
The gauntlets slid over his hands, and finally, the sleek, white-gold helmet descended, the golden visor flaring to life for an instant before the entire suit sealed with a soft, pressurized hiss.
|Symbiotic Link established. Neural interface is online. Existential framework is... compatible.|
|All systems are green. Welcome to the driver's seat, Master.|
HUUM!

He was encased. And for a moment, there was only a profound, absolute silence. Then, a blinding, white-blue brilliance blazed all around him, a light so pure and so potent that it seemed to erase all other colors from existence.
He opened his eyes.
And he saw....
Glory.
He blinked as he did not so much feel like he was encased in a suit as much as he was being cradled...by existence itself!
As if his body was floating in a sea of stellar cosmic space, with his vision blazing with stellar briliance!
A second, more powerful Existential Trembling bloomed from him, a shockwave of pure, unadulterated power that made the very walls of the laboratory groan.
Elara watched, her crimson eyes shining, her own 500 Quadrillion in complexity allowing her to stand firm in this storm of becoming.
For Noah, the feeling was indescribable. The armor clasped onto his existence, and it felt like he had just grown a new pair of wings, a new set of limbs he had always been missing.
The moment the connection was absolute...
BOOM!

He felt his very existence explode, not in destruction, but in potential. It was as if he had just discovered a second skeleton within himself, a grander, more magnificent framework that his current form was a mere shadow of!
And in that instant, his being was rapidly, violently catalyzed to expand, to elevate, to fill that new, impossible skeleton.
His Heart of Tyranny began to beat faster and faster, a furious, glorious drum against the anvil of his ribs.
From his skeletal structure, from his bone marrow, from every system and organ of his being, a new, torrential flood of life was being born!
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Drops of Blood of an Early Creature!
They were being produced en masse, a river of crimson-gold potential that surged from his heart, through the humming engine of the Modulator, and then... into the armor!
His blood, his very life force, flowed through the intricate, golden lines of the Aegis, filling it, claiming it, making it truly his own.
The armor was no longer a suit he was wearing; it was another limb, another organ, a part of him. His entire existence was lit up on fire!
|Cataclysmic Evolution Event Detected!|
|Analysis: The symbiotic link between [The Keystone Modulator] and [The Aegis of the Architect] is acting as a conceptual enzyme, a catalyst for all existential processes.|

|Your internal systems are undergoing a hyper-accelerated state of evolution. Your existential hematopoiesis, the production of the Blood of an Early Creature, has been amplified by a factor of one thousand. Your body is now a forge, and you are creating the very fuel of your own advancement at an unprecedented rate.|
|This is not a temporary boost, Master. This is a permanent upgrade to your operating system. You are now in a state of glorious, ongoing, and constant evolution!|
BOOM!
He felt it.
Oh, he felt it!
He was changing, moment by moment, his very being becoming more than it was. The armor was not just a shell; it was a catalyst, a partner in his endless, desperate climb!
|[The Aegis of the Architect] has been deemed a critical component of your existence, on par with your Heart and your Atlas. It will grow alongside you.|

|System Update: The unfathomably vast construction of the [Ascendran Nodule] is proceeding faster than ever before. The [Early Atlas of the Folds] is also being spurred to new activity and amplification.|
He was encased in a protective coating of pure, conceptual certainty, a being of terrifying power who could now decimate existence with a thought.
At this time, he spoke. Two simple words, but they were not the words of a man, or even a king. They were the words of Tyrannical Emperor!
"I. Am."
HUUM!
His voice was deeper, denser, each syllable an undeniable law.
|New Features Discernible Post-Integration.|

|[Absolute Purity Control]: Your voice, amplified through the Aegis, now carries the full weight of your Purity. Those who possess a lesser Purity will find themselves unable to easily deny your words. Your commands will be followed.|

|[Existential Trembling (Active)]: You can now consciously perform an Existential Trembling. This will cause a state of temporary, absolute immobility on any being with a lesser Purity than yourself.|

|[Innate Omnichalcum Aura Field] (Upgraded): Can now withstand damage in excess of 350 Quadrillion. All absorbed force is converted into Existential Kinetic Authority, which can be released in a single, terrifying burst.|

|[Inactive Mode]: The full cowling of the armor can remain so and cover you at all times. Alternatively, you can place it in inactive mode. It will transform into a Justiciar necklace, operating at 50% capacity.|
Oh.
Oh!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 4266 Struggles and Advancements! IV
paragraphs: Noah breathed in, a slow, deep intake of the recycled, perfectly filtered air within his new skin.
The white and gold armor was a masterpiece of lethal elegance, its lines both beautiful and brutal.

On his back, the Modulator hummed, a glorious blue light pulsing from its core. His entire existence now gave off the terrifying feel of a primal, ancient predator that had just been given a new, sharper set of claws.
He looked at himself.
Others took millions or billions of years to advance where he was and at the rate he was advancing.

But when he had Perpetual Harvest amplifying his existence, Cheating Architect amplifying his existence, RUIN/EDEN amplifying his existence, and now gaining another thousandfold amplification from this glorious living, growing armament...how could he not catch up and exceed all these monsters that needed millions of years?!
HUUM!
The further one traversed in complexity and purity, thr harder it was to gain more!
In the past day, Noah should have been feeling a pinch the moment he crossed 1 Quadrillion.
Lesser beings would have said man, reaching 2 Quadrillion is going to be even harder!
And yet.
And fucking yet...!
Less than a day later, he was not approaching 2 Quadrillion, but surging towards the 100 Quadrillion marker in Complexity and Purity.
And when he added other parts of him, his Modulator alone allowed that marker to be exceeded, and now his other part of him- his own Living Existential Armor...granted him 300 Quadrillion Purity!
Who said traversing existence was hard? Who said attaining Complexity and Purity only became harder?!
"Merely Complexity...merely Purity!"
HUUM!
His voice, a heavy and deep thing, boomed out again as existence trembled.
Elara looked at him, and for the first time since he had met her, she clapped her hands, a sound of pure, unadulterated, scientific glee. Her eyes shone with a brilliant, almost manic, light.

"We have to do some field tests!" she exclaimed, her voice filled with a joyous, almost dangerous, excitement. "We will exit the Early Laboratories and enter the First Folds to test out just how effective it is!"
Elara was already talking about field tests, her voice a buzz of scientific excitement that was a stark, jarring contrast to the profound, internal symphony of becoming that Noah was experiencing.
He was still acclimating, still charting the new, expanded coastlines of his own existence!

The Aegis of the Architect was not just a suit of armor; it was a new organ, a second skeleton, a partner in his very being, and with every passing second, its integration deepened, its boons becoming more and more apparent!
So much so that after just a few moments passed...
|Master, the ongoing evolution catalyzed by the symbiotic link with your armor is producing... unexpected results.|
|Your Early Atlas of the Folds is experiencing the most significant amplification. The fusion with a material containing unique clusters of Everythings has granted it a new, profound capability.|
|New Ability Unlocked: [Atlas Doorway].|

|Function: While you are physically present in the Earliest Folds, your one hundred and fifty-nine Vital Lighthouses can now synchronize and form a stable, one-way doorway. Through this Atlas Doorway, you can transfer items, resources, or materials directly from your location in the past to your Radiant Shore in the present.|
|Limitation: The doorway is not stable enough to allow for the passage of any lifeform. It is a cargo lift, not a time machine. At least, not yet.|
Oh!
A glorious, ongoing process of evolution. The armor was actively upgrading the very foundations of his power!
The moment Noah read the description of the Atlas Doorway, of the ability to pass resources from this primordial age to his own, his gaze, which had been turned inward, snapped open.
The brilliant, blue-gold light of his visor swept across the lab and settled on the mountain of vibrant, lustrous Early Omnichalcum Metal off to the side.
His mind, a silent engine of tyrannical ambition, raced. He had to have this material!
To reproduce a version of the Justiciar armor for his people... it was no longer a distant dream, but an actionable plan.
The numbers would be limited, yes, but if he could give an Aegis to Khor, to Malphas, to Sigrid, to his son... the possibilities were glorious!
A silent command was given. Deep within the internal weavings of his Atlas, the one hundred and fifty-nine Vital Lighthouses blazed as one.
Their combined light began to weave together, not into a lemniscate this time, but into the framework of a new, impossible structure. A doorway!
As the doorway began to form in the conceptual space of his being, Noah turned his helmeted gaze towards Elara.
His voice, amplified and deepened by the Aegis, was a calm, resonant note in the quiet lab. "Can I take some of the Early Omnichalcum Metal for... research purposes?"
Elara blinked, her scientific fervor momentarily checked by the mundane request. And his deep commanding voice...seemed extremely agreeable for some reason!
She looked at the massive pile of metal, then back at him. "Sure," she said, a hint of her old, condescending tone returning.

"But this metal is unique. You can't really place it in a separate storage dimension or anything similar. It resists such simple manipulations. You would have to hoist it around the whole time. It is a logistical nightmare. I can apply for you to get your own designated supply for your own lab, after all, if we can verify the capabilities of your Living Existential Armor..."
Her words trailed off into a stream of procedures. Noah listened, his expression unreadable behind the golden visor.
And then, he acted.
An ocean of blue mana surged from him.

It was not a violent eruption, but a calm, inexorable tide that washed over the entire laboratory. It wrapped around the mountain of Omnichalcum, every single block, every last piece. And then, the entire mountain began to rise!
It floated in the air, a testament to a power so boundless, so absolute, that it made the very concept of weight seem like a polite suggestion.

The mountain of primordial metal drifted towards his massive, white-gold form. And on his chest, the intricate, layered plates of the Aegis retracted, opening a small, circular doorway, a portal into the very heart of his being.
|[Atlas Doorway] formation is complete. Ready for transference.|
HUUM!

Noah began to funnel the metal. Not in pieces, but the entire, liquid mass of it, which flowed like a river of stellar white light through the opening in his chest. It disappeared into the conceptual space within him, passing directly through the Atlas Doorway, traversing the impossible gulf of eons to arrive in his Early Veiled Shore, countless years in the future!
Oh!
Stop for a second, and just think of what a terrifying capability this was.
To steal a mountain of such metal from the dawn of time and have it delivered to his own, private sanctuary in the present!
It was a theft on a scale that transcended mere criminality and entered the realm of existential temporal grand larceny!
And it all stemmed from his grand foundation, his Atlas, now empowered even more by his Justiciar.
In mere moments, the entire mountain of Early Omnichalcum Metal was gone. The laboratory, once dominated by its immense, silent presence, now felt... empty.
Elara stared, her mouth agape, her eyes wide with a mixture of shock and a dawning, terrible awe.
She pointed a trembling finger at him, her voice a choked, exasperated squeak. "You...! I said take a little!"
WAA!
|Transference Complete.|
|Units of [Early Omnichalcum Metal] transported to the Radiant Shore: 7,342.|

|Analysis: Based on the schematics for the [Aegis of the Architect], this quantity is sufficient to forge approximately 10-12 additional growth-type Living Existential Armors, or a significantly larger number of less... bespoke, non-growth models.|
Noah looked at the empty space, then at Elara's apoplectic face.
He felt the slight, almost imperceptible hum of his new armor, the steady, reassuring beat of his own, impossible heart.
As if he had done nothing wrong...
"You mentioned Field Tests? In the First Folds?"
Elara: "..."

A doorway!
As the doorway began to form in the conceptual space of his being, Noah turned his helmeted gaze towards Elara.
His voice, amplified and deepened by the Aegis, was a calm, resonant note in the quiet lab.
"Can I take some of the Early Omnichalcum Metal for... research purposes?"
Elara blinked, her scientific fervor momentarily checked by the mundane request.
And his deep commanding voice...seemed extremely agreeable for some reason!
She looked at the massive pile of metal, then back at him.
"Sure," she said, a hint of her old, condescending tone returning.
"But this metal is unique.
You can't really place it in a separate storage dimension or anything similar.
It resists such simple manipulations.
You would have to hoist it around the whole time.
It is a logistical nightmare.
I can apply for you to get your own designated supply for your own lab, after all, if we can verify the capabilities of your Living Existential Armor..."
Her words trailed off into a stream of procedures.
Noah listened, his expression unreadable behind the golden visor.
And then, he acted.
An ocean of blue mana surged from him.
It was not a violent eruption, but a calm, inexorable tide that washed over the entire laboratory.
It wrapped around the mountain of Omnichalcum, every single block, every last piece.
And then, the entire mountain began to rise!
It floated in the air, a testament to a power so boundless, so absolute, that it made the very concept of weight seem like a polite suggestion.
The mountain of primordial metal drifted towards his massive, white-gold form.
And on his chest, the intricate, layered plates of the Aegis retracted, opening a small, circular doorway, a portal into the very heart of his being.
|[Atlas Doorway] formation is complete.
Ready for transference.|
HUUM!
Noah began to funnel the metal.
Not in pieces, but the entire, liquid mass of it, which flowed like a river of stellar white light through the opening in his chest.

It disappeared into the conceptual space within him, passing directly through the Atlas Doorway, traversing the impossible gulf of eons to arrive in his Early Veiled Shore, countless years in the future!
Oh!
Stop for a second, and just think of what a terrifying capability this was.
To steal a mountain of such metal from the dawn of time and have it delivered to his own, private sanctuary in the present!
It was a theft on a scale that transcended mere criminality and entered the realm of existential temporal grand larceny!
And it all stemmed from his grand foundation, his Atlas, now empowered even more by his Justiciar.
In mere moments, the entire mountain of Early Omnichalcum Metal was gone.
The laboratory, once dominated by its immense, silent presence, now felt... empty.
Elara stared, her mouth agape, her eyes wide with a mixture of shock and a dawning, terrible awe.
She pointed a trembling finger at him, her voice a choked, exasperated squeak.
I said take a little!"
WAA!
|Transference Complete.|
|Units of [Early Omnichalcum Metal] transported to the Radiant Shore: 7,342.|

|Analysis: Based on the schematics for the [Aegis of the Architect], this quantity is sufficient to forge approximately 10-12 additional growth-type Living Existential Armors, or a significantly larger number of less... bespoke, non-growth models.|
Noah looked at the empty space, then at Elara's apoplectic face.
He felt the slight, almost imperceptible hum of his new armor, the steady, reassuring beat of his own, impossible heart.
As if he had done nothing wrong...
"You mentioned Field Tests?
In the First Folds?"
Elara: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 4267 Discoveries, Inventions, and Glory! I
paragraphs: The air outside Commander Elara's personal lab was still, sterile, and humming with a quiet, intellectual energy.

It was a stark contrast to the storm of emotions that was currently brewing within the Commander herself. She floated beside Noah, her arms crossed, her eyes a mixture of profound annoyance and a grudging awe.

"It just... disappeared?" she grumbled, the words a low, frustrated hiss. "An entire mountain of one of the rarest, most conceptually dense materials in all of existence, and you're telling me it just 'disappeared'?"
Noah, now clad in a sleek, white-gold, tight-fitting body wrapping that did little to hide his glorious, muscular figure, simply shrugged.
His Aegis of the Architect was in its inactive form, a beautiful, intricate necklace of white and gold that rested against his clavicle.
"That's what it looked like to me," he said, his voice a mask of infuriating, deadpan innocence.
Elara let out a sound that was somewhere between a sigh and a growl. She didn't insist.

He had performed so many impossible feats in her lab in the last hour, from rewriting the very principles of their most important project to casually integrating a piece of wonder into his own spine, that the spontaneous disappearance of a mountain of metal was, frankly, one of the less reality-breaking things she had witnessed.
But she was curious. And she would get her answers.
They arrived in a region where three of the massive, white walls of the labyrinth converged.
At the center of this triangular clearing, a vibrant silver portal pulsed with a steady, rhythmic light, its surface a shimmering, liquid mirror.
It was guarded by two Early Creatures, their forms still and silent as the statues that lined the Juridical Sanctum, their immense power a quiet, suffocating pressure on the air.
Even with his Aegis in its inactive form, Noah felt a glorious, silent aura of power swirling around him.
The Innate Omnichalcum Aura Field was a constant, invisible companion, a promise of absolute defense.
His gaze, now enhanced by a hundred different systems, was a thing of impossible clarity.

He could see across half of the Early Laboratories, his perception cutting through the maze-like walls to observe the countless Early Creatures, Fold Dwellers, and massive glass and stone structures that made up this impossible place.
The silver portal before him was just one of many, each one guarded, each one a potential exit from this grand, sterile prison of a laboratory.
His gaze settled on the two Early Creature guards, and his new Existential Command Interface instantly provided their details.
|[Protector Theron]|
|Classification: Early Creature|
|[Protector Liana]|
|Classification: Early Creature|
For the first time since he had begun his impossible journey, he looked at the staggering, world-breaking power of an Early Creature, and he thought, with a cold, thrilling certainty...
'Yeah. I could take them.'
HUUM!
It was a glorious, intoxicating sensation, the feeling of a predator that had finally grown into its claws!
Elara floated forward, her authority flaring for a moment. "A Commander and an Assistant are passing through," she announced, her voice a sharp, clear command. "Official business."
The Early Creatures looked at each other, their ancient, starlit eyes holding a silent conversation.

Theron, the one with the lower complexity, stepped aside, a low, rumbling warning in his thoughts. "Be careful, Commander. Weavings of the Followers of Gilgamesh have been observed nearby. They may be looking for a way to gain anything they can from us again."
Gilgamesh.
The name was a thunderclap in the quiet of Noah's thoughts! A pulse of pure, unadulterated glory, a thrill of ancient, burning thoughts shot through him!
He wanted to kill that fucker.
In this era, in his own, in any era he could find him. It was a promise he had made to himself, a debt that would one day be paid in blood and collapse.
Of course, that was if he was powerful enough.
The Followers of Gilgamesh were beings of immense, terrible power. But now... now he might be able to match the weaker ones.
Elara waved her hand dismissively at the warning, as if the machinations of a primordial entity were a minor, bureaucratic annoyance.
She looked at Noah, who had been lost in his own, violent thoughts. "Osmont," she said, her voice a sharp, impatient prod. "Let's go."
Noah's eyes refocused, the burning thoughts receding back into a cold, calculated desire for future vengeance.
He nodded, and the two of them stepped into the shimmering, silver portal.
Brilliance flashed all around them, a momentary, disorienting bath of pure, transitional light.
An instant later, they appeared in the middle of a vast, primordial forest, another silver portal surrounded by three similar white walls and two more Early Creature guards standing behind them.
They only gave Noah and Elara a passing glance as Elara hummed, a sound of eager, scientific anticipation, and began to fly away from the portal.
The two of them had stepped into the First Folds!
It was a realm of breathtaking, terrifying scale, a world that had not yet been tamed by the neat, ordered laws of later ages.
The trees were not trees; they were titans, their unfathomably massive trunks, thousands of miles in diameter, rising up into a sky that was a swirling, chaotic canvas of nascent folds.
The vegetation was incandescent, every leaf, every blade of grass, every flower glowing with its own, internal, primordial light!

The air was thick, heavy, and sweet with the scent of creation, a perfume of pure, untamed life. And in the skies above, floating islands the size of worlds, their undersides draped with waterfalls of glowing, life-giving sap, drifted like lazy, gentle wonders.
They had arrived in a place of pure, unadulterated, and extremely dangerous, life.

Elara laughed, a sound of pure, unrestrained, scientific glee. "We will stay within the defensive parameters of the Early Laboratories," she said, her crimson eyes blazing with an excited, predatory light.
"But that still gives us a few light-years to play with. Now... let's find something to hunt."

chapters.title: Chapter 4268 Discoveries, Inventions, and Glory! II
paragraphs: While two Entities were about to begin their hunt, it was good to understand one of the sources of power that made them.
Principles!
Were Principles discovered or invented?
It is a question that shook the very foundations of power, a conundrum that separates the artisans of reality from the mere observers!
Did the fundamental weavings that govern existence lie dormant, waiting for a sufficiently powerful intellect to stumble upon them, dust them off, and give them a name?
Or were they acts of pure, audacious creation, the imposition of a grand, new idea upon a formless, chaotic reality?
To answer this best, consider for a moment, mathematics. Is it discovered, or is it invented?
Across the Folds, a brilliant Fold Dweller in a world filled with brilliant minds was asked such a question!
He stood on a stage under a single spotlight, the cosmos projected behind him.

He began, his voice a mixture of childlike wonder and profound, academic certainty. "Is math real?" he asks the darkness. "Did we invent the number '2', or was the concept of 'two-ness' always there, waiting in the wings for a clever primate to come along and give it a symbol? Or Pi. That strange, irrational, never-ending number. If you take any perfect circle in the universe, from a single atom to a galactic disk, and you divide its circumference by its diameter, you get Pi. Every. Time. Without fail. Did we invent that relationship? Or did we simply stumble upon a fundamental, pre-existing truth of a universe that happens to like circles?"

This astounding Fold Dweller then pointed to the stars behind him. "Prime numbers. Numbers divisible only by themselves and one. They seem random, chaotic. Yet, their distribution, their very nature, is a fundamental building block of number theory. We didn't create the primes. We found them, hiding in the numerical landscape like strange, solitary animals. We are...explorers in a jungle of logic that was here long before we were."
"We didn't invent the speed of light; we just figured out how to write it down. Our mathematics is an invented framework to describe a discovered reality."
WAA!
Discovery or invention!
It is a question that, in a time before time was a straight line, was posed in a different, far grander context.

In the Earliest Folds, when the shackles that had bound THE Living Paradox for eons finally, inexplicably, dissolved, the first entity it went to see was not an enemy, not an ally, but a memory. It went to see THE Creature.

THE Living Paradox appeared before the silent, contemplative being, its form a shimmering, chaotic mirage of all possibilities at once. It wore a wry, cold smile, an expression that held the weight of a billion stolen years.
"Did you miss me?" it asked, its voice a chorus of a thousand different selves speaking in perfect, terrible harmony.
THE Creature, a being of pure, foundational essence, frowned. A gesture that was not of anger, but of a deep, ancient weariness.
"I am not the same as I was all the way back then," it replied, its voice the sound of a Fold being born. "I will not be so easily swayed now."

THE Living Paradox laughed, a sound that was both a symphony and a cacophony. "Then and now... what is the difference? I could paradoxically move to that moment all the way back then, and the 'me' from then could come here now. Everything is relative."

It drifted closer, its chaotic form a stark, violent contrast to THE Creature's serene stability. "But as THE Creature, I wanted to ask you what you thought about Principles, now that you are playing with so many of them. Did they always exist, and you simply discovered them, nurturing them to alter an Existence that was already there? Or did you invent them, acts of pure, audacious will to bend a formless Existence under your rule?"
The question was a blade, a test, a game. THE Creature looked at THE Living Paradox, at this being of infinite, tormenting questions, and it gave an answer that was not an answer, but a philosophy.
"Existence," it began, its voice a low, resonant hum, "will do what existence wants to do, whether anyone understands why or not. Principles always existed behind the veil of Existence. "

THE Creature's voice was a quiet, profound echo. "We... you, me, THE others... we simply try to create different formulas, to nurture different Principles, so that we can better understand the Existence that is already here. The Principles made by others, the ones you see blossoming across the Folds, were all made following a set of rules, a template, that Existence already had in place. It is all... to better understand Existence."

It turned its gaze, which contained the light of the first Folds, upon THE Living Paradox. "Is that not what makes for the First Scale of Civilization? Not the power to command, but the capacity to understand."
It was a heavy answer.
And one that THE Living Paradox smiled devilishly at!
"Oh, how I missed you, O Creature! We...will have so much fun together!"
In the very same Earliest Folds.
At a different time.
In the vast corner of the endless First Folds, Noah and Elara flew across tall trees rapidly.
Noah flew beside Elara, a silent, white-gold comet against the swirling, nascent Wheels and Folds that served as a sky.
"The location of the Laboratories was chosen with a specific purpose in mind," Elara said, her voice a sharp, clinical note in the symphony of the primordial world.
They were moving at a speed that would have torn lesser beings apart, yet she spoke as if they were taking a casual stroll.

"It is situated at the nexus of several... volatile regions. The Abyssal Chasm of the Collapsed, the Whispering Mire of forgotten concepts, and the Andran Nest of Inevitabilities. It allows us to dispatch our forces to collect samples and do field tests with varying degrees of enemies."
She gave him a sideways, almost challenging, glance.
"Otherwise, if we were just anywhere in the First Folds, we might only find weak things. Beings who only have the power of Young Early Creatures."

chapters.title: Chapter 4269 Discoveries, Inventions, and Glory! III
paragraphs: Weak things. The term was a casual, dismissive brushstroke that painted beings from one to one hundred Quadrillion in complexity as little more than bothersome insects.
Noah shook his head internally at the sheer, arrogant scale of power that was considered baseline in this ancient, terrible place.

"Today," Elara continued, a cruel, almost joyous, light entering her crimson eyes, "I was thinking we would pay a visit to the Nest of Inevitabilities. It has been a while since I had the chance to rip apart those mindless, hungry things."
The words were a stone dropped into the quiet, still waters of Noah's existence.
He felt a sudden, violent lurch in his own existence, a tremor that did not come from him. Inside his consciousness, Khor, who had been a silent, observing presence, stirred.
Her voice was not a whisper; it was a blade of pure, frozen rage.
"Outsider," she hissed, her thoughts a venomous current in the river of his mind, "do you have the power to kill a bitch like her yet? She might have outlived her uses."
She spoke of killing Inevitabilities, her children, her kin, as if they were vermin. In front of a listening First Hunger!
Noah's flight came to an abrupt, absolute halt.
The air around him shimmered as he stopped his momentum instantly. Elara, a few hundred feet ahead, paused and turned, an eyebrow raised in question.
"No Inevitabilities," Noah said, his voice a calm, flat, and utterly non-negotiable command.
"We will go to one of the other dangerous areas."
Elara blinked, a flicker of confusion in her crimson eyes. She opened her mouth to argue, to question, but there was something in his gaze, a quiet, tyrannical weight that sought no dissent.

She sighed, a sound of mild, professional annoyance. "Fine," she said. "If you have an aversion to cleaning up pests, we can go elsewhere. We'll go to the... Frostfang Peaks. It is home to the Primordial Verdant Trolls. They are an interesting species. Beasts that have grown complex enough through unknown means, likely by devouring a large cluster of Everythings at their genesis. They are territorial, aggressive, and their King... he is a worthy specimen for testing."
Noah nodded, the cold fury of Khor in his mind slowly receding.
They changed course, their forms streaking across the impossible, primordial landscape.

They passed over forests of trees so tall their canopies were lost in the swirling nebulae of the sky, over rivers of what looked like liquid starlight, and through swarms of strange, bioluminescent creatures that sang with a silent, psionic energy.

They arrived in a region of stark, breathtaking beauty. A massive green and white snowy mountain, its peaks so high they seemed to scrape the very firmament of the Fold, shone with a radiant, internal light.

Its perimeter alone was a cacophony of bestial roars, a symphony of territorial fury. Around the mountain, radiant, floating islands of green, verdant earth, each with its own waterfall of pure, life-giving water, drifted like silent, loyal sentinels.

The mountain itself was teeming with life. As they drew closer, they could feel thousands upon thousands of eyes turning towards them, gazes filled with a raw, primal intelligence and an uncomplicated, murderous intent.
All across the verdant, snow-dusted slopes of the mountain, massive, verdant-black Trolls, their bodies a fusion of living rock and primordial moss, watched them.
And at the very peak, sitting upon a throne of pure, unblemished ice like a king surveying his domain, was a verdant Yeti.
It was a titan, a being the size of a small world, its fur the color of a winter forest, its eyes two burning, ferocious crimson stars.
|Location Identified: The Frostfang Peaks.|
|Analysis of local biome is complete. Scanning for all biological and existential threats...|
|Threats Identified:|
| - [Primordial Verdant Trolls]: 13,472 individuals detected.|
| - Power Range: 1 Quadrillion (Juvenile) to 350 Quadrillion (Elder).|
| - [Yeti King - Borborygmos]: 1 individual detected.|
| - Power Range: 495 Quadrillion Complexity and Purity.|
|Master, this is a target-rich environment. I would advise a strategic, tactical approach. Or, you know, you could just walk in there. Your call.|
Noah locked his eyes with the world-sized Yeti King. He saw the numbers, the staggering, almost insurmountable power of the beast.
Elara, beside him, clapped her hands with a sound of pure, unadulterated, scientific glee.
She looked at the monstrous creature, then at him, her eyes blazing with an excited, predatory light.
"Osmont," she declared, her voice a theatrical, almost playful, challenge. "I choose you! Go!"
So, the field test was to be against a creature whose power was, on paper, just a bit more than his own.
His own base complexity, even after the endowments, was still catching up to the boons from the Modulator and the Aegis. This would not be an easy fight. It would be a struggle!
A Struggle.
A slow, dangerous smile spread across Noah's face. This was good.
He understood something fundamental about struggle. Struggle was the whetstone upon which his own, tyrannical will had been sharpened.
Whenever he had struggled, whenever he had been pushed to the very brink of his limits, he had always, always, emerged with the most glorious, most impossible loot.
So...
HUUM!
He began to float forward, a lone, magisterial figure against the backdrop of a mountain teeming with monsters.

He moved towards the swarm of Trolls, towards their King, all by himself. His body was still clad in the simple, sleek white-gold wrappings, his Aegis a silent, beautiful promise resting against his clavicle.
He looked small, insignificant, a single, defiant spark against a raging, bestial inferno.
And he had never felt more powerful!
The first to meet him were the Juveniles.
Primordial Verdant Trolls, each the size of a small mountain, their bodies a fusion of living rock and primordial moss, their eyes burning with a simple, brutish rage!
They roared, a sound that shook the floating islands around them, and surged forward.
Noah did not even bother to activate his Aegis.
He met their charge, a single, white-gold meteor against an avalanche of green and black!
He relied on his own, newly reforged strength, on the quiet, humming promise of the Innate Omnichalcum Aura Field that swirled invisibly around him!

sentences.text: Weak things.
The term was a casual, dismissive brushstroke that painted beings from one to one hundred Quadrillion in complexity as little more than bothersome insects.
Noah shook his head internally at the sheer, arrogant scale of power that was considered baseline in this ancient, terrible place.
"Today," Elara continued, a cruel, almost joyous, light entering her crimson eyes, "I was thinking we would pay a visit to the Nest of Inevitabilities.
It has been a while since I had the chance to rip apart those mindless, hungry things."
The words were a stone dropped into the quiet, still waters of Noah's existence.
He felt a sudden, violent lurch in his own existence, a tremor that did not come from him.
Inside his consciousness, Khor, who had been a silent, observing presence, stirred.
Her voice was not a whisper; it was a blade of pure, frozen rage.
"Outsider," she hissed, her thoughts a venomous current in the river of his mind, "do you have the power to kill a bitch like her yet?
She might have outlived her uses."
She spoke of killing Inevitabilities, her children, her kin, as if they were vermin.
In front of a listening First Hunger!
Noah's flight came to an abrupt, absolute halt.
The air around him shimmered as he stopped his momentum instantly.
Elara, a few hundred feet ahead, paused and turned, an eyebrow raised in question.
"No Inevitabilities," Noah said, his voice a calm, flat, and utterly non-negotiable command.
"We will go to one of the other dangerous areas."
Elara blinked, a flicker of confusion in her crimson eyes.
She opened her mouth to argue, to question, but there was something in his gaze, a quiet, tyrannical weight that sought no dissent.
She sighed, a sound of mild, professional annoyance.
"Fine," she said.
"If you have an aversion to cleaning up pests, we can go elsewhere.
We'll go to the...
Frostfang Peaks.
It is home to the Primordial Verdant Trolls.
They are an interesting species.
Beasts that have grown complex enough through unknown means, likely by devouring a large cluster of Everythings at their genesis.
They are territorial, aggressive, and their King... he is a worthy specimen for testing."
Noah nodded, the cold fury of Khor in his mind slowly receding.
They changed course, their forms streaking across the impossible, primordial landscape.

They passed over forests of trees so tall their canopies were lost in the swirling nebulae of the sky, over rivers of what looked like liquid starlight, and through swarms of strange, bioluminescent creatures that sang with a silent, psionic energy.
They arrived in a region of stark, breathtaking beauty.
A massive green and white snowy mountain, its peaks so high they seemed to scrape the very firmament of the Fold, shone with a radiant, internal light.
Its perimeter alone was a cacophony of bestial roars, a symphony of territorial fury.
Around the mountain, radiant, floating islands of green, verdant earth, each with its own waterfall of pure, life-giving water, drifted like silent, loyal sentinels.
The mountain itself was teeming with life.
As they drew closer, they could feel thousands upon thousands of eyes turning towards them, gazes filled with a raw, primal intelligence and an uncomplicated, murderous intent.
All across the verdant, snow-dusted slopes of the mountain, massive, verdant-black Trolls, their bodies a fusion of living rock and primordial moss, watched them.
And at the very peak, sitting upon a throne of pure, unblemished ice like a king surveying his domain, was a verdant Yeti.
It was a titan, a being the size of a small world, its fur the color of a winter forest, its eyes two burning, ferocious crimson stars.
|Location Identified: The Frostfang Peaks.|
|Analysis of local biome is complete.
Scanning for all biological and existential threats...|
|Threats Identified:|
| - [Primordial Verdant Trolls]: 13,472 individuals detected.|
| - Power Range: 1 Quadrillion (Juvenile) to 350 Quadrillion (Elder).|
| - [Yeti King - Borborygmos]: 1 individual detected.|
| - Power Range: 495 Quadrillion Complexity and Purity.|
|Master, this is a target-rich environment.
I would advise a strategic, tactical approach.
Or, you know, you could just walk in there.
Your call.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4270 Discoveries, Inventions, and Glory! IV
paragraphs: A colossal, stone-like fist, wreathed in an aura of ten Quadrillion in complexity, smashed towards him.
He did not evade. He met it with his own. The impact was a silent, terrible thing.
The Troll's fist did not just stop; it shattered!
BOOM!
The force of Noah's blow, amplified by a body that was now part Everything-metal, traveled up the creature's arm, turning rock and flesh to powder!
The Troll's roar of fury turned into a silent, bewildered scream as its entire upper body was simply... unmade.
Blood, thick and viscous and the color of old gold, flew across the primordial sky!
Another Juvenile, its maw filled with teeth like jagged mountains, tried to swallow him whole.
HUUUM!
Noah simply flew straight through its head, his body a missile of pure, unadulterated power, leaving a perfectly circular, cauterized hole in the creature's skull!
He moved through them like a force of nature, his every blow a final, absolute verdict!
Their immense bodies, which could have crushed cities, were as fragile as glass before him.
He split them, he broke them, he unmade them!
Oh!
And as the first few fell, their colossal, broken forms tumbling down the mountainside, a new, chilling voice echoed in his mind.
|[The Aegis of the Architect] is detecting a high concentration of ambient, unclaimed Everythings from your defeated enemies, Master.|
|New Feature Unlocked: [The Tyrant's Feast].|

|Function: The Aegis, as a symbiotic partner, now seeks to aid in your growth. It will actively "drink" the Everythings of defeated enemies, devouring what is left of their existence to refine it into pure, usable Purity for it and you.|
|Analysis: It seems your new armor has an appetite. I recommend you feed it.|
Noah's lips curved into a cold, predatory smile. He tapped the intricate, white-gold necklace that rested against his clavicle!
In the next instant, he was no longer a man. He was a Creature of War!
The Aegis of the Architect materialized around him, a silent, perfect symphony of interlocking white and gold plates.
The golden visor flared to life, a sun in the growing twilight of the mountain. And then, the feast began!
Oh!
HUUM!

Tendrils of pure, white-gold light, sharp as spears, erupted from the armor. They shot out, piercing the corpses of the fallen Trolls. The massive, mountain-sized bodies were instantly pulled towards him, not as whole forms, but as streams of unraveling data, of shredded existence!
They were broken down, consumed, and absorbed into the very fabric of his armor.
And as they were, the pristine white of the Aegis began to take on a faint, almost imperceptible, red hue.
The more he killed, the more he devoured, the redder his armor would become.
|[The Tyrant's Feast] is active. Devouring the essence of [Primordial Verdant Troll]...|
|Purity Refined: +500 Trillion. This has been added directly to your own existence and the Aegis.|
The other Trolls, seeing their brethren not just killed but utterly consumed, roared with a new, deeper fury.
From the peak of the mountain, the great Yeti King, Borborygmos, rose to his full, world-sized height.
He waved a colossal, furred hand, a gesture of absolute command!
And in response, the mountain itself came alive.
Thousands of Juvenile and Elder Trolls, their eyes now blazing with a bloodthirsty, crimson light, surged from every cave, every crevice, every shadow.
They surrounded Noah, a living, breathing, and very angry sphere of teeth and claws and pure, primal power.
Noah looked at the swarming, screaming horde, and he laughed!
A deep, resonant, and utterly joyous sound amplified by his new armor. He was a wolf in a field of very large, very angry sheep!
He moved. His speed was a violation of physics, a blur of white and gold that left streaks of light in the air.
He was a tempest of controlled, brutal violence. He used the capabilities of the Aegis, testing its wonders, its limits.
He activated the [Tyrant's Gait], and with every step he took in the air, a wave of pure, oppressive Haki washed over the Trolls, slowing them, weakening them, making them easy prey.
He used the [Weaver's Gauntlets], his hands now extensions of the Artifice system, and he wove!
A simple [Weave of Imposition] turned a charging Elder Troll's stone-like hide to brittle glass.
A [Weave of Distillation] stripped another of its chaotic, regenerative aura, leaving it vulnerable!
He was a whirlwind of death. He ripped through their titanic bodies, each hundreds of miles in size, as if they were nothing more than blood bags.
A punch would shatter a jaw the size of a mountain range. A kick would cave in a chest that could have housed a city!
HUUM!
And with every kill, the white-gold tendrils of his armor would lash out, drinking, devouring, refining.
The red hue of his armor deepened, from a faint blush to a rich, arterial crimson.
|Purity Refined: +705 Trillion...|
|Purity Refined: +520 Trillion...|
|Kinetic Energy Stored: 38.7 Quadrillion.|
But the Trolls were relentless!
They were a tide of pure, primal fury, and for every one he killed, two more seemed to take its place.
The Elder Trolls, beings of over 300 Quadrillion in complexity, were a somewhat genuine threat.

One of them, a gnarled, ancient creature whose very presence seemed to warp the space around it, managed to land a blow, its colossal club smashing into Noah's side with the force of a colliding planet.
Noah was sent hurtling through the air, a white and gold comet that smashed through three of the floating islands, shattering them into dust!
Dust!
Ashes to ashes, dust to dust!
|Kinetic Energy Stored: 188.9 Quadrillion.|
He emerged from the debris, his armor unscratched, his internal systems humming with a glorious, exhilarating energy. But the time for playing with the children was over!
The Yeti King moved!
Its speed was a paradox. A being the size of a world should not have been able to move that fast!

It was simply there. One moment, it was on its throne of ice at the peak of the mountain. The next, its colossal fist, now wreathed in the light of a collapsing, ten-layered Fold, was smashing down upon him. The very sky seemed to crash, to fall, to end!

chapters.title: Chapter 4271 Discoveries, Inventions, and Glory! V
paragraphs: The blow connected. Noah was driven down like a nail, smashing into the side of the mountain with a force that sent a shockwave across the entire area.
A massive, continent-sized crater bloomed on the face of the Frostfang Peak that spread out for thousands of miles!
But even as the Yeti King looked down, its crimson eyes burning with a triumphant fury, a figure rose from the heart of the crater.
Noah. His armor was still pristine, his posture still one of arrogant, unyielding defiance.
He was not injured, much less daunted as everything about his armoref majesty pulsed with activity and immensity!
He looked up at the world-sized titan, and he bellowed, his voice a glorious, amplified roar that shook the heavens. "COME!"
WUU!
The word was almost like a command, and his voice held a glorious, enticing allure.
The two of them flew towards each other. Their speed was a thing of pure, conceptual terror, a velocity that had left light behind as a quaint, provincial notion!
Light! What the fuck was that?!
BOOM!
Their impacts were not sounds; they were events, detonations of pure power that decimated the mountain and shattered the nearby floating islands into clouds of primordial dust.
His figure, tiny and small, smashed onto this beast of 495 Quadrillion Complexity and Purity as he was pushed back slightly, but he remained unfettered!
His Resistances were working. His Justiciar was working.
Perpetual Harvest burned, Cheating Architect burned...to hurt him or injure hid existence...took a great deal of effort as the damage thst was actually passed through was less than 300 Quadrillion!

And this was him relying on his Justiciar alone as he did not unleash his Goad or his Heart to burn with bloody purple flames, but the Justiciar was the part of him that was the most powerful at this moment.
HUUM!
During their impossible, high-speed ballet of destruction, Noah would occasionally break off, a flash of white and gold that would carve through a nearby Elder Troll before re-engaging the King.
The infuriated roars of Borborygmos echoed through the Fold as he watched his children being used as mere snacks in the middle of their duel!
And so, the Yeti King, its patience finally, utterly exhausted, pulled out its trump card.
A brilliant, verdant light, tinged with a strange, almost mathematical coldness, began to shine from its heart.
The light of a Principle.
Oh!
|Warning: A Defective Principle has been detected.|
Not a Seed of a Principle.
A Defective Principle!
|[The Principle of Absolute Territory]: Within a defined area, the wielder's authority is supreme. All other authorities are suppressed. All actions are amplified.|
|Analysis: It is a flawed, incomplete Principle, but it is a Principle nonetheless, Master. I would advise... caution.|
Noah felt it. A crushing, oppressive weight that was not physical, but conceptual.
His Haki was dampened. His Weaves became sluggish, difficult. The very air had become his enemy, the space around him now the personal property of the Yeti King!
He was no longer just fighting a being of immense power; he was fighting a fundamental weavings of this small corner of existence!
He was...struggling. And it was glorious!
BOOM!
The Yeti King, shining within verdant brilliance, brought its fists down like a hammer of endings as it burned with Early Existential Authority and the Authority of a Principle.
For minutes that felt like eons, they fought.
Noah was pushed back, his armor battered by blows that now carried the absolute weight of a Principle.

But with every blow, with every desperate, clawing exchange, he was growing. He continued to carve through the Elder Trolls, his armor drinking their purity, its crimson hue now a deep, bloody scarlet.
|Purity Refined: +950 Trillion...|
|Purity Refined: +980 Trillion...|
|Kinetic Energy Stored: 447 Quadrillion.|
The glorious, desperate battle continued. He was learning, adapting, his own power, his own will, pushing against the oppressive law of the Yeti's Principle!
And then, he crossed a threshold.
THUMP!
The combined Purity of his own being and the Aegis surged past the 500 Quadrillion mark.
Oh.
Oh!
The tide turned.
His movements became sharper, faster. His blows, once just powerful, now carried a new, undeniable weight.
He activated the [Absolute Purity Control] of his armor, and his voice was no longer just a sound, but a weapon.
"KNEEL," he commanded!
He! Commanded!
HUUM!
And the Yeti King, for a single, infinitesimal moment, faltered, its own authority struggling against his.
He unleashed the stored energy.
|Releasing all stored [Existential Kinetic Authority].|
|Projected Yield: 621 Quadrillion Purity.|
A beam of pure, incandescent white-gold light erupted from his chest, a torrent of repurposed violence that was not just an attack, but a statement.
It slammed into the Yeti King, and for the first time, the great beast was sent reeling back, a roar of pure, unadulterated pain tearing from its throat.
The battle became a slaughter. Noah was now the predator, his every move a masterpiece of brutal, overwhelming force.
He was faster, stronger, his every blow shattering the Yeti's defenses.
He tore through its furred hide, ripped apart its stone-like muscles, and painted the snowy peaks of the mountain with its crimson-gold blood!
He continued to do so as seconds passed, their surrounding landscape razed and decimated to oblivion!
Until...
Finally, the great beast fell.
It crashed to the ground, its world-sized body shaking the entire area, holes torn through it, its form shredded and bleeding from a thousand different wounds.
Its Principle flickered.
Noah stood over it, his own armor now a deep, glorious crimson, the color of a victorious, blood-soaked Emperor.
He felt the exhilarating, soul-deep satisfaction of a hard-won, desperate victory!
And then, he finished it.
His body shot down like a star, a final, absolute verdict. He crashed through the Yeti King's skull, a gory, triumphant explosion of bone and brain matter and pure, conceptual power.
And as he stood amidst the carnage, his armor, no longer just a defense, but an instrument of his hunger, radiated a thousand white-gold tendrils.
They sank into the massive, world-sized titan, and the final, glorious feast began.
|[The Tyrant's Feast] is active. Devouring the essence of [Yeti King - Borborygmos]...|
|Total Purity Gained: +25,200,000,000,000,000 (25.2 Quadrillion).|
|A [Preserved Defective Seed of a Principle] has been analyzed and stored. The [Principle of Absolute Territory] is now available for further study.|
|Congratulations, Master. You have won.|
Oh!

The Yeti King, shining within verdant brilliance, brought its fists down like a hammer of endings as it burned with Early Existential Authority and the Authority of a Principle.
For minutes that felt like eons, they fought.
Noah was pushed back, his armor battered by blows that now carried the absolute weight of a Principle.
But with every blow, with every desperate, clawing exchange, he was growing.
He continued to carve through the Elder Trolls, his armor drinking their purity, its crimson hue now a deep, bloody scarlet.
|Purity Refined: +950 Trillion...|
|Purity Refined: +980 Trillion...|
|Kinetic Energy Stored: 447 Quadrillion.|
The glorious, desperate battle continued.
He was learning, adapting, his own power, his own will, pushing against the oppressive law of the Yeti's Principle!
And then, he crossed a threshold.
THUMP!
The combined Purity of his own being and the Aegis surged past the 500 Quadrillion mark.
Oh.
Oh!
The tide turned.
His movements became sharper, faster.
His blows, once just powerful, now carried a new, undeniable weight.
He activated the [Absolute Purity Control] of his armor, and his voice was no longer just a sound, but a weapon.
"KNEEL," he commanded!
He!
Commanded!
HUUM!
And the Yeti King, for a single, infinitesimal moment, faltered, its own authority struggling against his.
He unleashed the stored energy.
|Releasing all stored [Existential Kinetic Authority].|
|Projected Yield: 621 Quadrillion Purity.|
A beam of pure, incandescent white-gold light erupted from his chest, a torrent of repurposed violence that was not just an attack, but a statement.
It slammed into the Yeti King, and for the first time, the great beast was sent reeling back, a roar of pure, unadulterated pain tearing from its throat.
The battle became a slaughter.
Noah was now the predator, his every move a masterpiece of brutal, overwhelming force.
He was faster, stronger, his every blow shattering the Yeti's defenses.
He tore through its furred hide, ripped apart its stone-like muscles, and painted the snowy peaks of the mountain with its crimson-gold blood!
He continued to do so as seconds passed, their surrounding landscape razed and decimated to oblivion!
Until...
Finally, the great beast fell.
It crashed to the ground, its world-sized body shaking the entire area, holes torn through it, its form shredded and bleeding from a thousand different wounds.
Its Principle flickered.
Noah stood over it, his own armor now a deep, glorious crimson, the color of a victorious, blood-soaked Emperor.
He felt the exhilarating, soul-deep satisfaction of a hard-won, desperate victory!
And then, he finished it.
His body shot down like a star, a final, absolute verdict.
He crashed through the Yeti King's skull, a gory, triumphant explosion of bone and brain matter and pure, conceptual power.
And as he stood amidst the carnage, his armor, no longer just a defense, but an instrument of his hunger, radiated a thousand white-gold tendrils.
They sank into the massive, world-sized titan, and the final, glorious feast began.
|[The Tyrant's Feast] is active.
Devouring the essence of [Yeti King - Borborygmos]...|
|Total Purity Gained: +25,200,000,000,000,000 (25.2 Quadrillion).|
|A [Preserved Defective Seed of a Principle] has been analyzed and stored.
The [Principle of Absolute Territory] is now available for further study.|
|Congratulations, Master.
You have won.|
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4272: Prisoners and Wars! I
paragraphs: As Noah decimated a Yeti King in one area of the First Folds, a victory that resonated with the raw, brutal music of his own becoming, another, quieter tragedy was unfolding.
Nearby, an unknown number of Fold Light Years away, a certain Living Concept sat in a daze, his very existence a weaving with a gaping, inexplicably blank patch.
He knew, with a certainty that was its own form of torment, that something was missing.
But he did not know what. It was a phantom limb of the soul, an ache for a memory that had been so perfectly, so clinically, excised that all that remained was the shape of its absence.
It is a phenomenon not unknown to lesser beings!

You walk into a room and forget why you entered. You know there was a purpose, a reason, a thought that propelled you across the threshold, but it is gone, leaving only the frustrating, maddening echo of its importance.
You stand there, a fool in a doorway, knowing you have lost something you cannot even name.

Schrodinger felt such a way right now. He sat amidst a field of verdant-gold grasslands, under the shade of trees so massive their canopies were lost in the swirling, nascent Wheels and folds of the sky.
But he felt no peace, no sense of belonging. He felt only a profound, hollow desolation!
He raised his hands to the endless, chaotic heavens, his fingers grasping at something, anything, a tangible piece of the puzzle that was his own, fractured mind.
And as his hands reached their apex, he saw them. Descending from the sky he was reaching out to, like three silent, falling stars, were the outlines of three hooded figures.
He blinked, a slow, stuporous movement, as he watched them descend.
They landed on the same verdant-gold grassland, their feet making no sound, their forms barely disturbing the air!
They were adorned in simple, archaic bronze robes, their hoods pulled low to cover their faces.
Where their faces should have been, there were only shifting, ethereal streams of auroral light, a constant, mesmerizing flow that made them impossible to truly see.
Schrodinger slowly came out of his stupor, a cautious, analytical light returning to his ancient eyes.
He could feel it, an oppressive sense of power radiating from them, a weight that was not of Complexity or Purity, but of something far older, far more fundamental.
“Who are you?” he asked, his voice a low, guarded rasp.

Their reply was a thing of impossible, terrible beauty. They spoke in perfect unison, three distinct voices...one high and melodic, one low and resonant, one a dry, academic whisper...all saying the exact same words at the exact same time.
“We are THE Weavers.”
HUUM!
THE.
Such a distinction was a crown of unimaginable weight, a title worn only by the very architects of reality.
Schrodinger, a being whose knowledge was a vast and labyrinthine library, felt a flicker of profound doubt.
He laughed, a short, sharp, and utterly unconvinced sound. He shook his head!

“THE Weavers?” he scoffed, a hint of his old self returning. “The titles of ‘THE’ are not trinkets to be worn by any passing specter. In all that is known, only THE Creature and THE Living Existences can lay claim to such a grand distinction.”
THE Weavers remained still, their hooded, faceless forms a silent triumvirate of mystery.
When they spoke again, their unison voice was a gentle counter-question.

“Because you have not heard of others, does that mean no others exist? Is your knowledge, vast as it is, the final measure of all that is? Or is it merely the boundary of your own, small garden in an existence that is an endless, untamed wilderness?”
Schrodinger fell silent. The logic was irrefutable, a perfect, elegant checkmate.
He was still not convinced, but he was no longer certain. He offered a cold, sarcastic smile.

“What is it that you want from me, O great and powerful THE Weavers? I am a man who has lost something I cannot even remember. A being who seems to know not where he is going. All I have is a single, echoing word... defective. Defective. Defective.”
At his bitter, self-deprecating words, the unison voice of THE Weavers softened, taking on a tone that was both eerie and grand.

“You are not defective, Elderborn. You have simply not found where you fit in this grand puzzle. And we are here... as a warning, and as a saving grace. Because a great many things are coming, and the vastness of existence... should at least have the chance to prepare. You are among those who can help.”
Schrodinger almost cursed.

“What bullshit is this?” he spat, his voice laced with a raw, frustrated anger. “A great many things are coming? Existence should be given a chance? If there were something so terrible on the horizon, then you... as existences with the distinction of ‘THE’... should move to stop it! You have more power than anyone ever could, do you not? So why the hell would you come to a being like me?”
WAA!
THE Weavers did not react to his outburst.
Their reply was as calm and as inexorable as the turning of the Wheel.

“A king may have the power to command an army, but if he has sworn an oath to never leave his castle, his commands are but wind. As powerful as we are, we attained our distinction by binding our Everythings to a single, immutable purpose. We cannot act, but we can inform. So we are here to inform.”
To inform. To inform about what?
Before Schrodinger could even form the question, their eerie, glorious unison voices began to speak again, not in conversation now, but in recitation.
“When the last Fold gutters and the final ember sighs into ash,
Know that the age of strength has passed.
The pillars of reality, whose foundations are power, shall be the first to crack,
And the thrones of the mighty will be but dust upon the wind.
In the silence of THE Creature, when the echoes of creation fade,
It is not the roar of the lion, but the whisper of the mouse that will be heard.
From the forgotten dust, a Herald will rise,
A being forged not in glory, but in the furnace of infinite misery.”
HUUM!
Their voices wove a weaving of grand, terrible images in Schrodinger’s mind!
